color.light.hover.source: Web resolveTheme fixed light --ui-hover; also the custom-palette value for base light

color.light.onAccent.source: Web resolveTheme --ui-on-accent: white or black, higher contrast against accent

color.light.overlay.source: Web resolveTheme fixed light --ui-overlay; also the custom-palette value for base light

color.light.danger.source: Web resolveTheme fixed light --ui-danger; also the custom-palette value for base light

color.light.controlBorder.source: UX decision vis-border-contrast (2026-10-13): fixed light value, >= 3 against pageBackground, panelBackground and hover; also the custom-palette value for base light

color.dark.hover.source: Web resolveTheme fixed dark --ui-hover; also the custom-palette value for base dark

color.dark.onAccent.source: Web resolveTheme --ui-on-accent: white or black, higher contrast against accent

color.dark.overlay.source: Web resolveTheme fixed dark --ui-overlay; also the custom-palette value for base dark

color.dark.danger.source: Web resolveTheme fixed dark --ui-danger; also the custom-palette value for base dark

color.dark.controlBorder.source: UX decision vis-border-contrast (2026-10-13): fixed dark value, >= 3 against pageBackground, panelBackground and hover; also the custom-palette value for base dark

textContrastMin.source: Web getContrastWarnings threshold; WCAG 2 AA normal text

nonTextContrastMin.source: WCAG 2 AA 1.4.11 non-text contrast; default palettes already meet it

focusMinWidth.source: Smallest existing focus ring: Web playback-controls 2px; others 3px (settings.json focusWidth, apps-menu, item-list)
